name: Twice Misplaced Trust
summary: A goblin asks you to carry an urgent package to Wharfmaster Whizzbuzz at Powderfuse Port. He trusts you after you rescued lost cargo and a captured goblin.

sections.title: A Courier Needed
sections.body: The goblin has another delivery to make, but he does not trust Zimmix with it. No other courier will be available before Zimmix, so he asks you to take the package to Wharfmaster Whizzbuzz at Powderfuse Port. You have already rescued lost cargo and a captured goblin, which has earned the sender's trust.

sections.title: At Powderfuse Port
sections.body: Whizzbuzz opens the crate and is surprised to find that Lozgil has finally sent what was expected. Lozgil was pressed by a harsh letter and a paid courier who threatened him. Whizzbuzz wonders whether a ship's captain was captured or a zeppelin crashed, then notes that the port has no zeppelin tower.

faq.q: Who asks me to deliver the package?
faq.answer: A goblin asks you to carry the package to Wharfmaster Whizzbuzz at Powderfuse Port.

faq.q: Why does the goblin trust me?
faq.answer: You have rescued lost cargo and a captured goblin, so the sender considers you trustworthy.

faq.q: Why not have Zimmix deliver it?
faq.answer: The sender does not trust Zimmix with this delivery.
The package is meant for Wharfmaster Whizzbuzz at Powderfuse Port in the Riverglades.
Lozgil is the one Whizzbuzz credits with finally sending the package.
Whizzbuzz is surprised when he peeks inside the crate and sees that Lozgil has finally sent what was expected.

attribution: In-game quest text: Twice Misplaced Trust
